rows.label: qst650603_0001
rows.name: What a beautiful little knife[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0002
rows.name: Did one of those guys drop it?

rows.label: qst650603_0003
rows.name: Huh[ML:Dash ] It doesn't look like a bandit's weapon.

rows.label: qst650603_0004
rows.name: Of course not.

rows.label: qst650603_0005
rows.name: They probably stole that treasure from somewhere.

rows.label: qst650603_0006
rows.name: You're right. They stole it from me.

rows.label: qst650603_0007
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ]When did this old man get here[ML:Dash ]
Without even M.O.M.O. noticing?

rows.label: qst650603_0008
rows.name: Sorry for startling you.

rows.label: qst650603_0009
rows.name: I'm Lazaro, a woodcarver.

rows.label: qst650603_0010
rows.name: A woodcarver[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0011
rows.name:
So you use this little knife
to carve wood?

rows.label: qst650603_0013
rows.name:
Um, what's wrong[ML:Dash ]
Did something happen to M.O.M.O.[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0014
rows.name:
M.O.M.O.[ML:Dash ]
Is that your name[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0015
rows.name: Yes.

rows.label: qst650603_0016
rows.name:
Sounds like there's a story here.
Lazaro-san, do you know M.O.M.O.?

rows.label: qst650603_0017
rows.name: No, that's not quite it.

rows.label: qst650603_0018
rows.name:
It's just that you look exactly like
my daughter, Rose[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0019
rows.name: Your daughter[ML:Dash ] Rose-san[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0020
rows.name: Rose loved curry with lots of Linka Honey[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0021
rows.name:
No, I suppose I shouldn't have
brought that up.

rows.label: qst650603_0022
rows.name:
That little knife has been my companion
for years of carving dolls.

rows.label: qst650603_0023
rows.name: It was never meant to hurt anyone.

rows.label: qst650603_0024
rows.name:
The way that blade shines[ML:Dash ]
Looks like nobody was cut with it.

rows.label: qst650603_0025
rows.name: That's good to hear.

rows.label: qst650603_0026
rows.name: Rex.

rows.label: qst650603_0027
rows.name: Let's return this knife to Lazaro-san.

rows.label: qst650603_0028
rows.name: Yeah, I think that's best, too.

rows.label: qst650603_0029
rows.name: That's settled, then. Here you go.

rows.label: qst650603_0030
rows.name: Oh[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0031
rows.name: Ah... Thank you, all of you.

rows.label: qst650603_0032
rows.name:
I've spent the last month trying to get it back,
but they were too strong. I was at my wits' end.

rows.label: qst650603_0033
rows.name:
But why would those bandits
steal a little knife like this?

rows.label: qst650603_0034
rows.name: That's rude, Prince.

rows.label: qst650603_0035
rows.name:
It can't be used as a weapon,
and it won't fetch much money, either.

rows.label: qst650603_0036
rows.name: No, you're quite right.

rows.label: qst650603_0037
rows.name:
What caught their eye
was the Life Stone.

rows.label: qst650603_0038
rows.name: Life Stone?

rows.label: qst650603_0039
rows.name:
It's a beautiful gem that glows pink,
small enough to fit in a child's hand.

rows.label: qst650603_0040
rows.name:
They say setting it in a doll's chest
breathes a soul into it.

rows.label: qst650603_0041
rows.name: That's amazing, mo!

rows.label: qst650603_0042
rows.name:
If I'd had one of those back then,
I wouldn't have needed lightning for Hana, mo!

rows.label: qst650603_0043
rows.name: Master, don't interrupt the story, mo.

rows.label: qst650603_0044
rows.name:
I'd finally managed to get a Life Stone,
but those bandits stole it from me[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0045
rows.name: So I went straight to their hideout.

rows.label: qst650603_0046
rows.name: How reckless[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0047
rows.name: It must have meant that much to him.

rows.label: qst650603_0048
rows.name:
But couldn't you at least have
asked a Merc Group to help[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0049
rows.name: I haven't got the money for that.

rows.label: qst650603_0050
rows.name: But to finish the present for Rose,

rows.label: qst650603_0051
rows.name: I needed that stone[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0052
rows.name: A present for your daughter[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0053
rows.name: [ML:Dash ]But they got the better of me,

rows.label: qst650603_0054
rows.name:
and even took my precious carving knife,
the tool I need for my livelihood.

rows.label: qst650603_0055
rows.name: That's terrible[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0056
rows.name: Um, Rex-san[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0057
rows.name:
I know, M.O.M.O.
Of course I'm all for it!

rows.label: qst650603_0058
rows.name: Huh? I haven't even said anything[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0059
rows.name: You don't have to say a word.

rows.label: qst650603_0060
rows.name:
We've been traveling together
all this time, after all.

rows.label: qst650603_0061
rows.name:
Tora and the others will get back
what's precious to Uncle Lazaro, mo!

rows.label: qst650603_0062
rows.name: Then tell us where their hideout is.

rows.label: qst650603_0063
rows.name: We'll go and get it back right away!

rows.label: qst650603_0064
rows.name: Oh... I don't know what to say[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0065
rows.name: Please, I'm counting on you[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650603_0066
rows.name: Yeah, leave it to us!

rows.label: qst650603_0067
rows.name: We'll make sure to get the Life Stone back!

rows.label: qst650603_0068
rows.name: According to Lazaro-san,

rows.label: qst650603_0069
rows.name:
the bandits' hideout is in the old quarry
in Invidia's abdomen.

rows.label: qst650603_0070
rows.name: Right, let's go!
